title: fix(spec): translateObject serves validations[].message in the reader's language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBKJfa3UpzWU4dnCYkeZNML4)_

Fixes #27135

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` L167 teaches `_validations.{rule_name}` as "`message` only — the sentence a rejected write returns", which stays true; no file under `skills/**` teaches which language `/meta` serves a rule's message in (grep `_validations`, `validations[].message`, `objectValidationMessageKey`, `translat` near `validat|rule`). No `skills/**` edit, so the PR is not governed.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`translateObject` 现在把对象每条校验规则的 `message` 按请求语言翻译,读取的正是规则校验器拒绝写入时用的那一个键(`objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE.message`)。
- **为什么改**:中文或日文部署里,服务器拒绝写入时提示是译文,而 `/meta` 下发的同一条规则仍是原文;看板上被规则关闭的泳道提示与拒绝提示是两种语言的两句话。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只改服务给读者的副本,不动 schema、不动写入判定;没有译文或规则无名时保持原文。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateObjectValidations`(键与回退);`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-locale-negotiation.test.ts` 新增的同串对照表;`packages/rest/src/meta-object-validation-message-i18n.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.object-validations.test.ts`,预期 12 条全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `translateObject` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) overlays each `validations[].message` through a new private helper, `translateObjectValidations`, the way it already overlays `fields`, `actions` and the embedded `listViews`.
- **One key.** The helper calls `objectValidationMessageKey(object, rule)` and walks that same dotted key through each locale's data, exactly as the served `II18nService` resolves it for the ObjectQL rule evaluator. No second spelling and no new key shape: a test pins that the retired top-level `validationMessages` shape and a bare `objects.OBJECT.RULE.message` both stay unread.
- **The evaluator's fallbacks.** A rule with no `name`, a bundle with no entry or an empty entry, and no bundle at all each keep the authored message. A `conditional` rule's branches are translated by their own names; the wrapper's own `message` is left as authored, because the branch supplies the violation (the extractor scaffolds no key for the wrapper either). Locale negotiation and the fallback chain are the shared `pickData` / `localeChain` every other overlay uses.
- When nothing matches, the authored `validations` array goes out by reference and a document with no `validations` gets no key added.
- No exported type, schema or `ObjectLike` member changes. Patch changeset for `@objectstack/spec`; the objectql and rest edits are tests only.
- **The kanban comment this PR makes false, fixed.** `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` (the closed-lane tooltip, `dropBlockedReason`, from #27133) said the text `/meta` serves is untranslated because the bundle does not reach `validations[].message` there. It now says `/meta` serves the bundle's `_validations.RULE.message` for the request locale, the same string the refusal uses. Comment only, no behaviour change; `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` gets a `patch` line in the same changeset.

## Why

Under a translated locale the server's refusal of a write that breaks a rule was translated, while `/meta` served the same rule's authored message, so a client explaining the rule (the kanban's closed-lane tooltip first) showed a different sentence, in a different language, from the refusal of the same move.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.object-validations.test.ts` (new, 12 tests). The bundle is parsed by `TranslationBundleSchema` and every entry is written at the path `objectValidationMessageKey` spells. Covers: the overlay in `zh-CN`, bare `zh` reaching `zh-CN`, the fallback chain then authored, the `/meta` door `translateMetadataDocument('object')`, no input mutation, the four fallbacks above, no other spelling read, and `fields` / `actions` output identical with and without `validations`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-locale-negotiation.test.ts`, one new case: for `zh-CN`, `zh`, `en` and `de`, the served rule's `message` (`translateObject` with the deployment's fallback as its chain, as `/meta` calls it) equals the refusal envelope's `message` for the same write against the same bundle.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-object-validation-message-i18n.test.ts` (new, 3 tests): `GET /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` and `GET /api/v1/meta/:type` serve the translated message under `zh-CN`, the authored one for a rule without an entry, and the authored ones under `en`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on `origin/main` `6866e2e7` first**, by ablation: with the one line that puts the overlay on the copy deleted (the resolver then serves exactly what main serves), 8 of the new assertions go red. The objectql cross-path table reads `served` = the authored English and `refusal` = the Chinese translation for `zh-CN` and `zh`, which is the card's defect, and both rest reads serve the authored message under `zh-CN`. Restored, all green.
- **Readers of `validations[].message` from `/meta`, measured under `ui/`.** The only one that shows it to a user is PR #27133's kanban closed-lane tooltip and screen-reader description (`ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx`, `dropBlockedReason`), which now shows the translated sentence. `state-machine-next-values.ts` reads `transitions` only. Studio's validations panel, `clientValidation.ts` and the deprecated `object-validation-engine.ts` run on Studio's draft or `/layers` baseline, which is untranslated, so nothing that edits a rule reads the translated copy and no translated message can be saved back. Nothing else changes.
- **No packaged-base comparison, on purpose.** The object's three scalars follow the ADR-0029 D9.2a divergence rule. A rule message is a flat `catalog ?? document`, like a field `label`, because the evaluator translates the refusal without any packaged base, and applying the rule here alone would serve one sentence on `/meta` and another in the refusal of the same write. Consequence: a rule whose message a tenant rewrote still gets the packaged translation in both places, consistently.
- **A second door, measured by the contract review (6467333940).** The public form route (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` ~L317) translates its object schema through the same `translateMetadataDocument('object')`, so the anonymous form's `validations[].message` is now translated too. That is the same direction as the refusal of that submit. The tenant-rewrite consequence in the bullet above is filed as #27221, which applies D9.2a to both readers together.
- **One locale edge, unchanged and shared with field labels.** When the requested locale is the deployment's `defaultLocale`, `/meta` skips the fallback chain (#15711) while the i18n adapter behind the refusal still tries its fallback locale. The two can differ only when the default locale's own bundle lacks the entry and the fallback locale's has it.

## Verification

Suites and ablation on head `ac138e64e` (the resolver and its tests); gates rerun on head `c8e5fee88`, which adds only the kanban comment and its changeset line. All under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared box. No plugin-kanban test was run: the edit is a source comment.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 476 files, 8889 tests passed. `typecheck` exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 333 files passed, 6555 tests passed, 326 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0.
- Ablation: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the anchor line (1 → 0, blob `06ccb909` → `a5de27ec`), spec rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exit 0. Red: spec 5 of 12, objectql 1 of 7, rest 2 of 3. Restore: blob back to `06ccb909`, `git diff HEAD` empty, spec rebuilt, preflight present in 2 dist chunks, objectql 7 of 7 and rest 3 of 3 green.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `c8e5fee88`: 85 derived, 85 exit 0 (11 of them rerun after building the `@objectstack/rest^...` closure and `@objectstack/client`, having first exited 3 for unbuilt output in the fresh worktree). `--ran` reconciliation: 85 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.

[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema change; the edit is in the existing i18n resolver.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is CI's run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (`check:generated`: nothing to regenerate.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is in Chinese by the repo's dispatch rule.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
